purpose: keep credentials out of source and logs, and make every secret rotatable and owned
entry_criteria: Inventory of secret types and stores exists or will be created in this stage
Secret manager or vault is available to the team
procedure: Scan the working tree and full history for credentials; record findings without printing secret values.
Treat every found credential as compromised: revoke and rotate it before removing it from code.
Move runtime secrets to the secret manager; reference them by name, never by value, in config and CI.
Add a pre-commit and CI secret scan that fails the build on new findings.
Record owner, rotation interval and consumers for each secret.
Get the secrets-owner's approval of the inventory and the rotation plan.
deliverables: secret inventory (names, owners, rotation dates; no values)
acceptance_criteria: Scan of history and tree reports zero active secrets or each is rotated
Every secret has an owner and a rotation date
No secret value appears in the evidence
validation_method: Secrets-owner approval, plus a rerun of the scanner on a clean clone.

validation.expect: exit 0; zero findings or all findings marked rotated

failure_modes.detection: Rotation log has no entry for a found secret
failure_modes.response: Rotate now; treat as BLOCKED until logged

failure_modes.mode: Secret value pasted into the report
failure_modes.response: Delete the report, rotate the secret, rerun with redaction

failure_modes.detection: A test commit with a fake secret passes CI

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: History scan finds a cloud access key committed two years ago. The key is revoked first, a new key is stored in the secret manager, CI is updated to read it by name, and the scanner is added to the pipeline.
